title: Photos – Quick and Photos – Keepers scan profiles
description:
## Parent

yomi-mj7

## What to build

See the photo scanning design (docs/superpowers/specs, 2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design), section Scan profiles and settings. New installs get the two built-in photo scan profiles instead of "Photos"; existing installs keep every saved scan profile and gain the two once, never re-added after deletion. `yomi scan --photo` scans with the Keepers settings, resolution from the existing dpi argument.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Fresh install: both photo scan profiles present, no "Photos".
- [ ] Upgrade from the settings fixture: originals unchanged, both added once; running the upgrade again adds nothing; a deleted one is not re-added.
- [ ] `yomi scan --photo` uses the Keepers settings; without it the tool behaves as before.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass.

title: Safety nets for upgrades
description:
## Parent

yomi-mj7

## What to build

Groundwork for both projects (the photo scanning design (docs/superpowers/specs, 2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design), Constraints; and the appearance and file output design (docs/superpowers/specs, 2026-11-14-appearance-and-file-output-design), Constraints). Saved scan profiles and app settings keep loading after any new setting is added: every field decodes with a default when missing, and the built-in photo scan profiles (fixed IDs) get new photo settings switched on when the key is missing while every other scan profile gets them off. Today's document output is fingerprinted so any later change to it fails a test. The step 1 plan (docs/superpowers/plans, 2026-11-14-photo-step-1-colour, tasks 1 and 2) describes this in detail.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A fixture of today's saved settings decodes to the same scan profiles, and re-encoding round-trips.
- [ ] A field missing from saved settings decodes to its default; the fixed-ID rule is covered for a built-in photo ID and for any other ID.
- [ ] Document output of each current built-in scan profile matches recorded fingerprints from a synthetic page.
- [ ] The app loads and saves settings through the tested code; no user-visible change.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass.

title: Color correction with the scanner's color profile
description:
## Parent

yomi-mj7

## What to build

See the photo scanning design (docs/superpowers/specs, 2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design), section Colour, and ADR 0001. Any scan profile can turn on "Correct colors with the scanner's color profile". Yomi finds Fujitsu's S1300 color profile at runtime (never committed) or lets the user choose it in Settings, converts photo pages to Display P3 without white balance, document tone or edge whitening, and warns in the progress panel and log when the color profile is missing. Step 1 plan tasks 4 and 5 describe this.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With color correction on and a color profile available, saved pages are Display P3 and differ from the sRGB result (tested with a macOS system profile standing in for Fujitsu's).
- [ ] With it off, output matches the document fingerprints exactly.
- [ ] Settings shows the color profile in use or Not found, and Choose… installs one.
- [ ] A missing color profile still saves the batch in sRGB and shows the skipped warning.
- [ ] Owner check after merge: a scan compared with the print in daylight (fallback in the design if worse).
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass.

title: Photo scanning
description: Parent for the photo scanning project. Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design.md. ADRs: docs/adr/0001, docs/adr/0002. Steps run in the order of the child issues; the Appearance and file output project runs between step 1 and step 2 (photo cropping).

title: Name files from their contents and learn from corrections
description:
## Parent

yomi-o9s

## What to build

Add name pattern pieces filled from the fields read in `yomi-o9s.4`, such as title, merchant/vendor, page date (not the scan date), and page kind. `yomi-ocr` fills them before saving; when a field is missing, the piece is left out, as other empty pieces are.

Remember the user's corrections locally, keyed by the normalized merchant or company and a Vision image feature print (`VNFeaturePrintObservation`) / `NLContextualEmbedding` of the page. For a new page, find the closest earlier one and apply its corrections directly (spelling of the merchant, naming), and include the most recent corrections as examples in the prompt. No model training.

## Correction UI & retention

- Show the auto-chosen file name in the finished progress panel with an inline edit/rename control, and keep the last ~15 batches accessible in a **Recent Scans** menu item in the menu-bar/Dock menu so edits work even after the panel closes. Editing renames the file on disk and records the correction rule. (Finder-rename detection may be added later.)
- Store correction rules indefinitely (LRU-capped at 500 entries) in `~/Library/Application Support/Yomi/`.
- Add a **Manage Learned Names…** sheet in Settings listing saved rules (`Matched text` -> `Replacement`, last used date) with per-row delete and Clear All.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A name pattern with the new pieces names rendered receipts and documents from their contents.
- [ ] Editing a name in the progress panel or Recent Scans renames the saved file and applies the correction on the next similar page.
- [ ] Learned rules can be inspected, deleted individually, or cleared in Settings.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass.

title: Read fields from business cards, receipts and documents
description:
## Parent

yomi-o9s

## What to build

In yomi-ocr, read fields with a `@Generable` struct for each page kind, prompting with the recognized text and the page image:

- Business card: the 14 fields ScanSnap Home reads (name, company, department, title, postal code, address, phone, mobile, fax, email, website, memo, location/region, business card date), plus readings for the name and company on Japanese cards. Strip leading `〒` from postal codes.
- Receipt: merchant, date, total, currency; for Japan also the 8% and 10% tax lines and the invoice registration number (`T` and 13 digits). Yen amounts have no decimals.
- Document: title and a short summary.

Phone numbers, emails, websites, addresses, dates and amounts come from `DataDetection` matches; a value the model returns is kept only if it agrees with one (with explicit Japanese `YY/MM/DD` validation for short numeric dates). Prompts tell the model to copy text exactly as printed. Use `tokenCount(for:)` to trim long pages to the 4,096-token context.

## Storage & review flow

- Save immediately without a blocking pre-save dialog; post-scan corrections happen afterward via the Recent Scans UI (`yomi-o9s.5`).
- Write core extracted metadata into the PDF Info dictionary (`Title`, `Subject`, `Keywords`) so Spotlight indexes it automatically.
- Add an optional per-scan-profile export toggle to also write a `.vcf` (vCard) sidecar for business cards and `.csv` / `.json` for receipts alongside the PDF.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Rendered English and Japanese business cards and receipts produce the expected fields.
- [ ] A model value that disagrees with `DataDetection` is dropped.
- [ ] PDF Info metadata (`Title`, `Subject`, `Keywords`) is written; optional `.vcf` / `.csv` / `.json` sidecars write when enabled on the scan profile.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass.

title: Sort pages into documents, business cards, receipts and prints
description:
## Parent

yomi-o9s

## What to build

In yomi-ocr, classify each page's **page kind** (see GLOSSARY.md: Document, Business card, Receipt, or Print). Ask the on-device model with the page image and a `@Generable` enum (0.5 s a page in testing). Use what Yomi already knows first: sheet size (a business card is about 91 x 55 mm) and whether the photo pipeline found a print. When Apple Intelligence is off or unavailable, fall back to sheet size alone.

Page kind only drives field reading (`yomi-o9s.4`) and file naming (`yomi-o9s.5`). It does not change the scan profile's save destination or split batches; for multi-page single-PDF batches, classify from the first page.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Rendered receipt, business card, and letter pages are classified as the right page kind when the model is available.
- [ ] With the model unavailable, card-sized sheets are classified as Business card and the rest as Document.
- [ ] Page kind does not alter save destination or batch splitting.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass.

title: Document text recognition and the text recognition language setting
description:
## Parent

yomi-o9s

## What to build

In `yomi-ocr`, replace `VNRecognizeTextRequest` with Vision's `RecognizeDocumentsRequest` for the PDF text layer, keeping each page's paragraphs, tables and `detectedData` as a per-page result the next steps use.

Add a per-scan-profile setting for the text recognition language: Automatic (default), English, or Japanese and English. It sets `textRecognitionOptions.recognitionLanguages` (turning off `automaticallyDetectLanguage` when a language is chosen) and the DataDetection options (`documentLanguageCode` ja and `documentRegion` JP for Japanese). Explicit Japanese and English is more predictable than Automatic: Automatic changed spacing in Japanese names in testing.

Lines that are much taller than wide (vertical Japanese) are drawn rotated in the invisible text layer, so selecting text in Preview highlights the right place. Japanese text needs no font change: Core Text falls back to a Japanese font, and PDFKit finds the text.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Rendered English and Japanese test pages produce PDFs whose text PDFKit finds, including a vertical Japanese column.
- [ ] Old saved scan profiles decode with the language set to Automatic.
- [ ] The setting appears in Settings for PDF scan profiles only.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass.

title: Searchable PDFs from a yomi-ocr helper
description:
## Parent

yomi-o9s

## What to build

See ADR 0003. Add a `yomi-ocr` executable target that `scripts/build-app.sh` copies into `Yomi.app/Contents/MacOS/`. When a batch's pages are ready and the scan profile saves a searchable PDF, Yomi writes the pages (JPEG data, as `PDFWriter` already embeds them) and a JSON manifest (resolution, JPEG quality, output URL) to a temporary batch folder, starts `yomi-ocr` on it and goes back to idle. `yomi-ocr` recognizes text, writes the searchable PDF to the output URL, removes the batch folder and exits. The text recognition moves out of `PDFWriter` into the helper; the `yomi` command-line tool can keep calling it in-process.

If `yomi-ocr` is missing, fails or is stopped, Yomi saves the PDF without a text layer, as when "Make PDF searchable" is off, and logs why. Turning pages upright and back captions stay in Yomi.

Keep `VNRecognizeTextRequest` in this step; switching recognizers is the next step.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A batch saved with a searchable PDF scan profile produces the same searchable PDF as before (text found by Finder search).
- [ ] Yomi itself never runs Vision text recognition for searchable PDFs; `yomi-ocr` exits after each batch.
- [ ] With `yomi-ocr` removed from the app, the batch is still saved as a PDF without text.
- [ ] Tests cover the manifest round trip and the fallback.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass.

title: Document intelligence
description:
Parent for searchable text, page sorting, field reading and naming from contents, done locally like ScanSnap Home. ADR: docs/adr/0003-ocr-runs-in-a-helper-after-each-batch.md. Steps run in the order of the child issues.

## Findings that shape the steps (macOS 27.2 SDK, measured on an M1 Max)

- Vision `RecognizeDocumentsRequest` (macOS 26+) gives paragraphs, tables, lists, barcodes and per-block `detectedData` (DataDetection matches). About 0.3 s a page once warm. Reads Japanese, including vertical text in the right column order.
- DataDetection reads Japanese era dates (令和8年3月14日), ¥ and 円 amounts, Japanese phone numbers and addresses. It reads `26/03/16` as 2016-03-26, so short numeric dates must be checked.
- FoundationModels `SystemLanguageModel.default`: 4,096-token context, image input (`Attachment(cgImage)`), `@Generable` typed output, supports Japanese. Sorting a page took 0.5 s; reading receipt fields 2.5 to 3 s (about 6 s for a Japanese card). It runs in a system service, so it adds almost nothing to the calling process. Needs Apple Intelligence turned on.
- No model read a small white-on-black date on a phone photo of a receipt; values the model returns must agree with DataDetection matches.
- No MLX models for now (see the ADR).

title: Text-based rotation misreads upside-down and some sideways pages
description: Found while building face-based rotation (yomi-mj7.3). OrientationDetector compares Vision's fast text recognition in each orientation, but fast recognition scores correctly read text and upside-down gibberish about the same (0.5 a line). A note fed upside down is not rotated; sideways feeds only rotate with five or more lines and in one direction, so a page fed sideways the other way may be turned upside down. Affects document scan profiles and the text fallback for photos.

description:

title: Captions show in Apple Photos
description:
## Parent

yomi-mj7

## What to build

See the photo scanning design (docs/superpowers/specs, 2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design), section Back captions (Photos fallback). Confirm that Photos shows the caption stored in the file after import; if it does not, set the caption through Photos' scripting interface, which asks once for permission.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass.

comments.author: John D'Elia
comments.text: Needs the owner: build the app (make app), scan a print with handwriting on the back using Photos – Quick, and check whether the caption appears in Photos. If it does, close this ticket. If not, an agent builds the Photos scripting fallback from the design. An agent can't check this without importing into the owner's real Photos library.

title: Detect prints fed back-side-first
description:
## Parent

yomi-mj7

## What to build

See the photo scanning design (docs/superpowers/specs, 2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design), section Back captions (which side is the picture). When a print goes in back-side-first, Yomi saves the picture side as the photo; when it can't tell, it trusts the feed direction.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A synthetic sheet with the picture on the back and plain paper with writing on the front is swapped.
- [ ] Ambiguous sheets are not swapped.
- [ ] Document scan profiles never swap sides.

description:
## Parent

yomi-mj7

## What to build

See the photo scanning design (docs/superpowers/specs, 2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design), section Auto-enhance, and the appearance and file output design (docs/superpowers/specs, 2026-11-14-appearance-and-file-output-design) (the _original naming rule). Photo scan profiles with auto-enhance save the enhanced photo plus an untouched copy named with _original, which uses no extra running number.

## Acceptance criteria

title: Back captions in saved files
description:
## Parent

yomi-mj7

## What to build

See the photo scanning design (docs/superpowers/specs, 2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design), section Back captions, and ADR 0002. When a print's back has writing, the recognized text becomes the caption stored inside the saved photo file and the back image is discarded. Brand printing and lab printing count as blank; only handwriting becomes the caption. Unreadable writing gives no caption.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A saved photo from a back with handwriting carries the text as a caption that Finder search finds.
- [ ] Backs with only brand or lab printing, or blank backs, give no caption and no saved back.
- [ ] Owner check after merge on real backs.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass.

title: Save to Apple Photos
description:
## Parent

yomi-mj7

## What to build

See the photo scanning design (docs/superpowers/specs, 2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design), section Saving to Photos. Each scan profile saves to Folder, Photos, or both; the built-in photo scan profiles use Photos only. The user picks an album or types a new one, created when first needed. Any Photos failure saves the batch to the folder instead and says so. App only.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Saving to an existing and to a new album works in the built app.
- [ ] With access denied, the batch lands in the folder and the progress panel says why.
- [ ] Settings decode and the fixed-ID rule cover the new settings.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass.

title: Face-based rotation for photos
description:
## Parent

yomi-mj7

## What to build

See the photo scanning design (docs/superpowers/specs, 2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design), section Rotation. Photo scan profiles rotate prints upright using faces first, then text, otherwise leave them as fed. Document scan profiles keep text-based rotation only.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A test image with faces in each of the four orientations comes out upright.
- [ ] An image with neither faces nor text is left as fed.
- [ ] Document fingerprints unchanged.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass.

title: Photo cropping
description:
## Parent

yomi-mj7

## What to build

See the photo scanning design (docs/superpowers/specs, 2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design), section Cropping. Photo scan profiles crop tightly to the print's own edges against the scanner backing, including dark prints and wallet, 3.5x5, 4x6 and 5x7 sizes, straightening small skews and never snapping to paper sizes. Document scan profiles keep today's crop.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Synthetic dark and light prints of each listed size, slightly skewed, crop to their edges within a small tolerance.
- [ ] Document fingerprints unchanged.
- [ ] Owner check after merge on real prints, including a very dark one.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass.
